title: Coprime composite local-order merge
objective: Construct independently complete local overorders for coprime composite discriminant supports and merge their certified lattices without whole-component factorization fallback

oracles: existing Buchmann--Lenstra independent checker and exact global lattice certificate

handoff.summary: Added a host-neutral helper that constructs and independently replays each composite local overorder from the equation order, continues only that component when necessary, rejects non-coprime merges, and delegates host materialization and lattice join through explicit callbacks. The exact degree-4 large-prime compositum regression proves both 387-bit and 731-bit local results complete independently, merges their lattices, checks closure and the square-index identity, and rejects an overlapping support.
risks: The maximal_order_engine.py call site is intentionally withheld because the T8 and OM-auto integration lanes currently share that file.
The full strict suite on base c7b9c853 has five unrelated existing errors in field_analysis_resource.py and maximal_order_engine.py; direct Pyright validation of the new module is clean.
Only Linux x64 focused execution ran in this lane; the helper is ordinary dynamic Python and still needs the repository's normal supported-host sweep after integration.
next_steps: After the shared engine lanes land, import certified_composite_overorder_from_equation and merge_certified_coprime_composite_order in maximal_order_engine.py.
Track processed composite supports, construct every pending composite from the equation order, and use the helper to merge complete results before prime-local work.
Add the new module to pyrightconfig.json and register the focused test in test/node-test-manifest.cjs in the integration lane.
Rerun the large-prime public case under the uniform 30-second policy and the full exact certificate suite.
